definition: Optic nerve damage, often with raised eye pressure, that quietly steals side vision first. Usually painless, so regular eye checks matter.
Height above sea level. Climb too fast and altitude sickness brings headache, nausea and bad sleep; fluid on the lungs or brain is the dangerous kind. Today is International Mountain Day.
Breast inflammation, usually while breastfeeding: a painful, red, hot area, sometimes with fever. Keep feeding gently; antibiotics if it’s infected.
Skin red, hot and sore from too much UV, and a step towards skin cancer. Christmas at the beach? Slip, slop, slap, seek and slide.
